# Welcome
This is your new notes database, content of note 1.
Template for daily entries, content of note 2.
Notes for current projects, content of note 3.

summary: Trilium Notes (TriliumNext): self-hosted hierarchical note-taking application with a SQLite backend. Users create/edit/delete notes organized in a tree of branches, attach attributes (labels/relations), revisions, and attachments, and persist options, recent notes, ETAPI tokens, and embeddings.
